style.summary: Headspace pairs white screens and warm grey #2B2A28 text with rounded vector art: smiling suns, soft circles and stripes in orange, yellow, pink and blue. Controls are full pills, from the 52 pt blue #0061EE Play button to the #F8F4F1 teacher row. Sleep content flips to navy #101340, and store shots frame the app in yellow and orange waves.

traits.label: Layout
traits.text: 24 pt side margins; content pages open on a full-width art header, then an about 30 pt title, a meta line and a paragraph.

traits.label: Shapes
traits.text: Buttons and choice rows are full pills, 50 to 52 pt tall; category tiles and cards round at about 12 pt.

traits.label: Color
traits.text: White #FFFFFF screens, warm grey #2B2A28 text, blue #0061EE Play buttons; sleep screens turn navy #101340; orange #FF7300 leads the art.

traits.label: Type
traits.text: Headspace Apercu Bold, tracked 3% tight, sets titles; Medium 500 sets 16 to 20 pt labels; Regular sets 19 pt chat text.

traits.label: Imagery
traits.text: Vector art of smiling suns, circles and stripes fills 7 of 8 shots; 1 shot shows a therapist photo.

traits.label: Components
traits.text: 2-column category tiles 167 pt wide, a teacher pick row with a blue radio, and a 52 pt blue Play pill.

trial.evidence: App Store description: “Start your free trial and experience the benefits of meditation, mindfulness and expert mental health therapy & coaching.”

ourRead: Annual opens preselected in a yellow card at $34.99, beside a struck $69.99. Monthly, $12.99, is the anchor: 12 months cost $155.88, so full-price Annual saves 55%.
The App Store offers a free trial. This web offer swaps it for 50% off year one: $34.99, then $69.99 a year.
The App Store lists 10 items at 3 prices under 4 names. "Headspace Plus" costs $12.99 or $94.99, exactly like "Headspace", so it is 1 tier.
stylePrompt:
Restyle my app in Headspace's style. Keep my features, data and copy.
Colors:
- 60% white #FFFFFF: screens and cards; text #2B2A28; soft fills #F8F4F1.
- 30% bright orange #FF7300: illustrations and key words in headlines.
- 10% cobalt blue #1A54F6: therapy screens; main buttons use its twin #0061EE.
- Sleep screens: navy #101340 with white text.
Type:
- Headlines: Hanken Grotesk 700, close to Headspace Apercu, about 30 pt, tracking -3%.
- Body: Hanken Grotesk 400, close to Headspace Apercu, 16 pt; labels at 500, 16 to 20 pt.
Shapes:
- Buttons and choice rows: full pills, 50 to 52 pt tall. Cards and tiles: 12 pt corners.
- Secondary buttons: white, 2 pt #E2DEDB border, 2 pt bottom lip #D2D1CF.
Layout:
- 24 pt side margins; full-width art header, then title, meta, paragraph, actions.
Components:
- Play button: #0061EE pill, white triangle and label.
- Choice row: #F8F4F1 pill, 38 pt avatar, label, 24 pt blue radio at right.
- Category tiles: 2 columns, saturated bases, clipped circles, centered white labels.
Icons and imagery:
- Vector art of circles, suns and stripes; white round icon buttons over art.
Check:
- Every primary action is a blue pill.
- Text is #2B2A28 on white or white on navy.
- Cards and tiles round at 12 pt.
